- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot post-peak sentiment (e.g., +0.44 sentiment → forecast too high).
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is negative or neutral; model reacts too slowly to bearish signals.
- Lag in response to sentiment shifts: model often delays correction by 1–2 days after sentiment changes.
- Mean reversion bias: model overweights recent highs/lows, fails to revert to 30-day moving average in 3–5 days.
- Forecast horizon error: 30-day forecasts consistently overestimate early in the cycle (e.g., 1st 5 days) and underestimate late (last 5 days).
- Sentiment-driven bias: when sentiment > 0.2, model tends to overreact; when sentiment < 0.1, model underreacts.
- Avoid “sentiment echo” — model replicates sentiment direction without adjusting for historical volatility.
